description:
Good desk lighting is the cheapest productivity upgrade there is, and one that furnished rentals in Lisbon almost never include. The Xiaomi Smart LED Desk Lamp 1S is a slim, app-controlled lamp that gives you the right light for whatever you are doing.

**Four modes, one knob**

Turn and press the dial to cycle brightness, colour temperature and four presets: Focus for deep work, Computer to reduce screen contrast, Reading for warm, even light on paper, and Child with reduced blue light for evening use. Output peaks at 520 lm with a colour temperature range of 2600 to 5000 K.

**Comfortable for your eyes**

A textured Fresnel lens spreads light evenly across the desk with no hot spots, the LEDs are rated Ra 90 for natural colour, and dimming is completely flicker-free, so long sessions cause less strain.

**Smart when you want it**

Connect the lamp to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and control it from the Xiaomi Home app or with Google Assistant, Amazon Alexa or Apple Siri. Set it to switch on for your morning start or dim automatically in the evening. It draws just 9 W and the LEDs are rated for 25,000 hours.

A simple, affordable add-on to any desk or monitor rental in Lisbon.
